title: Nte Gymna Species
paragraphs: “It looks like it’s hard to hit a smaller target, but wouldn’t it also be difficult for Rifana to attack after shrinking?”
“I wonder about that—”
Before Father could finish speaking, the weasel that was supposedly big sister’s friend switched to the offensive.
“Here I come! Sha sha sha sha!”

Whoosh… Big sister’s friend moved at several times the speed from before and began brushing Kou’s body without using her claws. Incredible speed. I could probably manage somehow, but even for me, it’s still pretty fast.
“Whoa! There’s more than one Rifana!?”

Big sister raised her voice in surprise. I had enough levels to see how big sister’s friend was moving, but since big sister lacked the speed, it must have looked to her as if Rifana had multiplied. No, there’s a trace of magic. Big sister’s friend is also skilled in fire illusions, so she’s likely creating the illusion of multiple copies to confuse her opponent.
“W-w-what!? Rifana multiplied!”

Kou was also shocked, desperately trying to follow big sister’s friend with his eyes. With several duplicates surrounding him, all of them brushing against his body… If this were an actual attack, the situation would be dire. Kou was completely overwhelmed, unable to do anything.
“W-what’s happening… Shaaaa!”
Big sister’s friend let out a noise that sounded both like a threat and laughter.
“Ahaha! That tickles! Rifana, stop it!”
“Okay.”

Big sister’s friend suddenly stopped and struck a pose with her back turned to Kou. At that moment, all of Kou’s feathers stood on end, and with a swift whoosh, unnecessary feathers shed and scattered into the air. With a thud, Kou collapsed face down.
“Ugh… I lost… Rifana is so small and hard to hit, and she’s so fast… I can’t win…”
Kou spoke to big sister’s friend with frustration.
“She was leaving afterimages.”
“I remember seeing a similar skill back in my gaming days…”
“Yeah, me too. It was a flashy skill.”

Ah, yes. There was a skill used by pugilists that left afterimages while attacking. It was a fairly decent offensive skill. I’ve never heard of a weasel using it, but that’s definitely what it looked like.
“I won! Victory roar! Shaaaa! Just kidding.”
It didn’t sound like a snake’s threat, but more like a cat… no, it was exactly like a weasel’s threat.
“Uh…”
“Ah! Naofumi-sama!”
The weasel, who seemed to be big sister’s friend, noticed Father and came running over. She leaped onto Father’s body and climbed up to sit on his shoulder.
“Whoa!”
Father raised his arm to keep her from falling, and big sister’s friend struck a pose on top of Father’s shield.
Was it a victory pose? Her right arm was raised diagonally, with her left arm slightly pulled back to follow.
Hmm…? This feels like something I’ve seen before.
“Did you see? What do you think?”

Big sister’s friend danced on top of Father’s shield, extending both hands forward and spinning as she struck another pose. Father, perhaps unconsciously, gently stroked her throat with his index finger.
“Yeah, I saw… You’re Rifana, right? You’ve gotten really small…”
“Yes! I was feeling really great today, and when I transformed, I felt like I could go one step further!”
“And when you tried it, this happened?”
“Yes!”

Big sister’s friend puffed out her chest with pride… but she looked completely like a weasel. Rather than a beastman, she felt more like a small animal. At this size and speed, she could be quite a troublesome opponent.
“Iwatani, I’m so jealous! You get to carry Rifana!”
Kou looked at Father with envy.
“Luna’s jealous too! Small and cute like Keel-kun!”
At some point, Luna had come over, carrying Keel in her arms.
“Rifana’s smaller than me! How strong is she now!?”
“I can move even faster than before!”
“That’s amazing!”
Big sister’s friend answered proudly.
What exactly is happening here?
“Sadina, do you know anything about this?”
“Oh… Hmm… I’m not entirely sure, but wasn’t there a legend in Siltvelt about beastmen achieving a second transformation?”
“Now that you mention it, wasn’t there a report about a beastman with that kind of skill among Takt’s group in Faubrey?”

Itsuki responded with a sudden realization. Ah, now that he mentioned it, I vaguely remember something like that. Since Takt’s subordinates were always taken down quickly, I hadn’t paid much attention to them.
“Ah… I think I heard something about the representative of Schildfrieden having that kind of ability. Maybe Rifana has a similar latent talent?”

Come to think of it… I recall Father saying something about analyzing Fohl back when he set out to conquer the world and mentioning that he had some hidden potential. It seems a similar potential has blossomed here.
“I’ll keep doing my best from now on!”
“Yeah. Keep it up.”
“Yes!”
Big sister’s friend was brimming with enthusiasm. Sakura and the rival were looking enviously at her as she struck a joyful pose atop Father’s shield.
“Naofumi’s attention is supposed to be on Gaelion! But Gaelion has to appeal as a mature woman, so I’ll hold back for now.”
“Sakura wants to shrink and dance with Rifana on Naofumi’s shield too!”
“Wanna do it?”
Big sister’s friend beckoned Sakura as if to say, “Come on.”
“Hmm! If Sakura’s doing it, Gaelion won’t hold back either! But… shrinking this much is hard for Gaelion…”
“You don’t have to compete, okay?”
Father looked troubled as he tried to stop big sister’s friend, Sakura, and the rival.
Exactly! Sakura is fine, but rival, you’re not!
“You’re being noisy.”

Just then, the doctor arrived. She had taken on the task of modifying the bioplant and had been bringing monsters from her own research lab to the village to take care of things. Thanks to the doctor, the village was gradually beginning to resemble the original world.
“Ah, Rat. Look at Rifana. It seems like she’s learned a second-stage transformation.”
The doctor stared at big sister’s friend, who was proudly standing on Father’s shield.
“Huh… So the Nte Gymna species can undergo a transformation similar to the Hakuko and Aotatsu species, which are known to have a second transformation.”
“Nte Gymna species? Is that Rifana’s race?”

“Yes. A few days ago, when I was helping with the Soul Vacuum research, I heard about it. Apparently, there are some demi-human species that can retain their consciousness even after death. Those are the Nte species. And the ones that can transform into beasts are the Nte Gymna species.”

Hmm? Did we have that conversation? Ah, now that I think about it, it was when I explained the methods we used to take down reincarnators, teleporters, and possessors based on the rival’s testimony. Father must have been talking to the doctor about it back then. By the way, the rival seems to remember those details quite well and apparently witnessed what the previous doctor was researching.
“Well, this isn’t exactly my area of expertise, but I’ve heard that in the region where this originated, it’s associated with dark magic and used as sacrifices in rituals.”
“I see… So that’s the kind of race Rifana belongs to.”
“No matter what happens, I am me! I’ll become even stronger and be of greater use to Naofumi-sama!”

Big sister’s friend wagged her tail, clearly excited. I understand that excitement of awakening to greater power myself. It’s a feeling of anticipation that’s rare and hard to experience, so I can’t blame her.
Chapter 804 – Desert of lost paths
“Curses and sacrifices, huh? It’s a harsh world, isn’t it?”
“It feels kind of Japanese. Based on what I’ve read online, would it be something like a pipe fox?”
“Ah… now that you mention it. From what I know, pipe foxes are said to resemble weasels more than foxes. Rifana’s species must be one that possesses such abilities.”
“Retaining a strong sense of self even after death…”
Big sister’s friend tilted her head toward big sister. Big sister, in turn, tilted her head as well.
“So, Naofumi-sama. What’s the plan for today?”
“About that… I need to discuss it with everyone.”

Father gathered the villagers and explained the plan to investigate the Prado Desert. Of course, it seemed a bit challenging, but the villagers expressed their interest in participating, finding it an exciting endeavor. However, considering the village’s restoration and other issues, everyone discussed the matter thoroughly. It was decided that big sister, her friend, and big sister’s older sister, who had high levels, would go as representatives. Among the filolials, Yuki would lead, with Kou, Sakura, and Kuro also participating. Luna seemed happy just to have Keel by her side.
“If something happens, you’ll come back immediately, right, big brother?”
“Yeah. Since we can return with the portal, we’re planning to stay at the village when possible.”
“The Desert of lost paths… The real issue is figuring out how to navigate through it.”
“If it’s a magical problem, leave it to Gaelion.”
It seems the rival also decided to join the expedition.
“Heroes, may I assist in discovering unknown monsters as well?”

Is the doctor coming too? It feels like a pretty large group. Well, since the assistant didn’t become a companion due to the rival’s decision, having the doctor help out is a fair exchange. With her analytical skills, she might uncover some useful hints.
“Well, if we encounter any issues, we can send a more detailed investigation team later. If we need more manpower, we’ll call for it.”
“Alright! I’m looking forward to it, big brother!”
“Exactly. For now, let’s take it easy. This isn’t about grinding levels… it’s an adventure focused on exploration.”
We all nodded in agreement.
“Then, we’ll depart as soon as preparations are complete!”

And so, we set off toward the Prado Desert. After that, we entered the Desert of lost paths by carriage, heading for the Prado Desert. Thanks to our high levels, it wasn’t too bad, but the desert’s unique terrain made traveling difficult. It’s hot during the day and freezing at night, making it quite a harsh environment. Based on what Father and some villagers who lived near the desert had told us, we decided to limit our travel to nighttime. The heat during the day was just too much. And so, we conducted our investigation at night.
“Is that the thing that looks faintly red?”
From atop a sand dune, we squinted and spotted a ruin-like structure faintly glowing red. Reaching that place was our objective this time.
“It certainly resembles the outlines of the Dracia Mountain Range when it’s active.”
“According to what the queen said, there’s also a theory that it might be a mirage.”
“A mirage… at night?”
“That’s the thing… but since this is another world where magic exists, there’s a legend that says it could be an illusion created by the remnants of a destroyed nation’s inventions.”
“Trying to explain it scientifically would be pointless, huh?”
“Exactly.”
“Either way, there’s something romantic about going to uncover its true identity.”

To be honest, I’m interested too. Back when this was still a game… it felt like a twisted space-time kind of setting. It was the type of event where you defeated a certain number of monsters and reported to an NPC to gain experience points.
“The desert looks a lot bigger than I thought on the map. I can see the destination, but whether we can get there or not…”
“Indeed.”
“Well, let’s give it a try and see.”
And so, we all began to move forward.

Traveling through the desert at night with the filolials… somehow, it feels like an Arabian adventure, doesn’t it? The filolials unique to this region, which we saw in the towns and villages we stopped by for information during the day, were beautiful. They seemed built to run on the sand, with a distinct leg shape adapted for the terrain.
“Na~no!”
“Naofumi-chan, Naofumi-chan! We found these clothes being sold in the previous town, so Gaelion-chan and I bought them!”

The rival and big sister’s older sister were wearing what looked like midriff-baring ethnic outfits. It gave off a very Arabian vibe… but I can’t really tell much of a difference with big sister’s older sister.
Was it called belly dancing or something like that? The flowing fabric left quite an impression.
“Ufufu! How do I look, Naofumi?”
Her blatant attitude irritates me, but then Sakura steps forward to block her.
Go, Sakura! You’ve got this!
“What’s with you? Don’t get in my way, Sakura.”
“Hmm!”
“Na~no!”
As sparks flew between them, big sister and her friend watched with exasperated expressions.
“By the way, I had Rifana and the others change into them too! How do they look?”

Big sister was also wearing something similar to what the rival and the others had on. Her friend, still in her weasel form, was wearing a turban on her head for some reason. She stood out quite a bit.
“How do we look?”
“Uh… well, it looks good on you.”
“Ehehe, thank you.”
“…Yeah.”
Her friend was delighted to be praised, but big sister looked embarrassed. Well, the outfit does show a lot of skin.
“Come on, Sakura, you should put one on too. I bought enough for everyone!”
“Well… I think it would suit Sakura. She could probably pull off a sword dance with dual blades.”
“Naofumi, do you want Sakura to wear it?”
“If it’s for the sake of my eyes, sure.”
“Okay, I’ll go change! I won’t lose to Gaelion. Rifana, Raphtalia, help me!”
“Okay! Can I pet Gaelion?”
“No, you can’t!”
“Ah, I want Kou to pet me instead!”
“That’s right! You can just stick to petting the filolials!”
Hahaha! Rival, it would be better if big sister’s friend just seduced you already. Father’s innocence—both in body and heart—must never be handed over.
Before that happens, big sister’s friend should just corrupt him first!
“Big sister’s friend! Hurry up and take down that rival!”
“What kind of order is that? And… well, I get that we’re dressing for the desert, but it feels like we’re just playing around…”
“That’s right! We’re not here to play!”
“We’re not playing either! We came here to become the rulers of the desert, the Sandwalkers!”
“No, that’s not right. You’re using the wrong term.”
Ren and Kuro were doing their usual comedy routine.
Should I be laughing at this? If I act carelessly, Father will probably get mad again, so I’ll just let it slide.
“But seriously… Ren and Kuro, are you guys okay? It’s cold now because it’s night, but during the day… I guess it’s fine since we can portal back if needed.”
Kuro and Ren both prefer wearing dark colors. In the desert, wearing black will just absorb heat and make things hotter.
“N-no problem! R-right, Kuro?”
“No matter the situation, if you calm your mind, even fire will feel cool. Heat means nothing to Kuro!”
Kuro struck a pose that he had clearly practiced with Ren, showing it off to us. To think Kuro knows a phrase like “calm your mind and the fire will feel cool.” Ren must have taught him that.
“Well, if that’s fine with you, I won’t stop you.”
And so, with this carefree conversation, we continued moving through the desert. Since we weren’t used to it, the sand kept dragging at our feet, making things troublesome.
“Hmm… no matter how far we go, it feels like we’re not making any progress. Even with the desert gear the filolials have on, it’s still tough to move forward.”
Father was using the map to give instructions. I was looking at the desert gear fitted on Yuki and the others. Hmm, with this, traveling through the sand should be much easier.
However…
“It feels like we’re getting closer… but also like it’s getting further away. It’s a strange feeling.”
